Credits

Original procedural geometry and textures. Photographs were used as visual references; their pixels are not included in the game.

Washington Square · NYU

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, available under the Open Database License (ODbL 1.0). The derived campus dataset in campus/data/campus-data.js is a Produced Work and, as far as it contains OSM data, is offered under the ODbL.

Building footprints and roof heights (5zhs-2jue), PLUTO (64uk-42ks), NYC Planimetric Database layers (roadbed, sidewalk, median, curbs, plazas), street Centerline (inkn-q76z), Forestry Tree Points (hn5i-inap), hydrants, bus shelters and parks properties from NYC Open Data, used under the NYC Open Data Terms of Use. No Google Maps or Street View imagery or data is included.

This is a fictional future ruin. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by New York University.

Reference photographs (Washington Square · NYU)

The detail pass used these Wikimedia Commons photographs as references for proportions, materials and details. Copies are kept in the repository under RESEARCH/reference/commons/ (author, licence, date and source page for each in ref-commons-meta.json). They are not used as game textures. The comparison images in RESEARCH/screenshots/detail/ place a photo beside a Commencement render and carry the photo's credit; each is shared under the licence of the photo it contains. The Bust of Sylvette was deliberately left out of the saved photographs.

Other campus sources

Building volumes from the NYC 3D Building Model (Office of Technology and Innovation, 2014), NYC Open Data Terms of Use. Landmarks Preservation Commission designation reports and Building Database (public records of the City of New York). Tower heights for the Paulson Center from the CTBUH Skyscraper Center. Google Maps and Street View were looked at as visual references for positions and capture dates; no imagery or data from them is included. Full list: RESEARCH/data/SOURCES.md.

The car

NYU Campus Safety unit 4 is an original body made for Commencement from simple shapes, sized and proportioned after Avi's reference photos of the real Campus Safety car; it is not modelled on any maker's design and carries no badges or logos. Its livery reproduces the real car's colours and plain lettering (CAMPUS SAFETY, NYU, the Campus Safety phone number, the unit number and "100% electric"), drawn in code; the NYU torch is left out. The reference photos were looked at only and are not included. The campus map on the passenger seat is drawn from the same OpenStreetMap and NYC Open Data as the world. The car's sounds are synthesized in the browser; no recordings are used.

Title screen and icons

The smoke title and the smoky C icon are original. Typeface: IM Fell English by Igino Marini, under the SIL Open Font License 1.1, bundled in assets/fonts/.

Surface textures

The brick, stone, concrete, cast-iron, asphalt and pavement detail maps (normal, roughness and ambient occlusion) are made from these materials on ambientCG, released under CC0 1.0 (public domain): Bricks101, Bricks105, Concrete012, Concrete034, Concrete047A, Travertine009, Metal027, Asphalt033. They were resized, packed into atlases and compressed to KTX2 by tools/build-pbr.mjs; the game keeps its own colours and uses the maps only for relief, grain and roughness.

KTX2 textures are decoded with the Basis Universal transcoder (Binomial LLC, Apache License 2.0), the Three.js KTX2Loader (MIT), ktx-parse (MIT) and zstddec (MIT, with Zstandard, BSD), vendored in dist/vendor/addons/.

Accuracy and reuse

Washington Square is a playable interpretation, not a surveyed replica. Footprints, heights and street geometry come from the data above; details are checked against the reference photographs and Street View (looked at, never copied), and anything estimated is marked as such in the research notes. No Google Maps or Street View imagery, API, tracing or data is used.

Commencement (called Commencement until October 2026) once included Times Square, SoHo and Shibuya corridors, other cars and archival advertising. They were removed in Step 10 and remain, with their own credits, in the git history and on the main branch.

The original procedural scene source is released under CC BY-SA 4.0, credited to sormazi / Commencement. Vendored Three.js retains its MIT license.
